## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Deep cervical lymphatic-venous anastomosis explored for CNS waste clearance in Alzheimer's](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/new-alzheimer-s-therapy-or-it)** — *Science*
  * Evaluates deep cervical lymphatic-venous anastomosis (dcLVA), a surgical procedure designed to increase lymphatic drainage from the central nervous system to facilitate waste removal.
  * Early case reports from China spurred rapid adoption across various medical centers, though clinical efficacy and safety remain unverified in controlled, randomized trials.

* **[Integrin β6-targeted CAR-T cells exhibit antitumor activity in preclinical models](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42594406/)** — *PubMed*
  * Preclinical findings demonstrate that CAR-T cells directed against integrin β6 (ITGB6) exhibit potent cytotoxic activity in ITGB6-positive pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and lung adenocarcinoma models.

* **[Targeted protein degradation review highlights lysosomal pathways](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42595562/)** — *PubMed*
  * Reviews emerging lysosome-targeted protein degradation platforms (e.g., LYTACs, AUTACs) that offer spatiotemporal control for degrading membrane-bound and extracellular targets.

* **[Multi-omic continuum defines stage-specific Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic disease transitions](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360091)** — *medRxiv*
  * Proteomic and metabolomic mapping across 355,724 UK Biobank participants identified 11 pan-stage proteins (including RTN4R, LEP) and 29 metabolites (including GlycA) associated with cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome.
  * Pathway analysis demonstrated a stage-dependent progression from metabolic/extracellular matrix dysregulation in Stage 1 to systemic inflammation in Stage 2, and hypoxia/fibrosis in Stage 3.

* **[Solid-state nanopore urinary hyaluronan size profiling improves urothelial carcinoma detection](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360208)** — *medRxiv*
  * Combined solid-state nanopore determination of urinary hyaluronan size distribution and concentration distinguished patients with urothelial carcinoma from controls with an AUC of 0.87.

* **[Metformin, PPIs, and antibiotics alter gut microbiome signatures relevant to CRC screening](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360274)** — *medRxiv*
  * Metagenomic profiling in a cohort of 1,034 screening-positive individuals demonstrated that long-term use of metformin, proton pump inhibitors, antibiotics, and analgesics significantly reshapes gut microbial composition.
  * Drug-induced shifts directly overlap with candidate microbial biomarkers utilized in colorectal cancer screening.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Regeneron candidate REGN17235 linked to CD98hc × CD3 bispecific engager](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2087898095635857696)** — *@JacobPlieth on X*
  * Cross-referencing patent filings and clinical trial inclusion criteria suggests candidate REGN17235 functions as an anti-CD98hc × CD3 T-cell engager entering initial clinical evaluation.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Epirium reports Phase 1b/2a RESOLVE trial symptom data in eosinophilic esophagitis](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087874292176302372)** — *@BioStocks on X*
  * Released symptom response results from the ongoing Phase 1b/2a RESOLVE study evaluating its lead asset in patients with eosinophilic esophagitis, detailing reductions in odynophagia.

* **[Biotech]** **[ProQR Therapeutics sets top-line data readouts for RNA-editing pipeline](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087875864180527272)** — *@BioStocks on X*
  * Expects top-line data from the 9 mg/kg cohort and 12-week follow-up in the Phase 1 trial of AX-0810 by the end of 2026.
  * Initial Phase 1 healthy volunteer data for follow-on RNA-editing candidate AX-0811 are also expected by EOY 2026.

* **[Brief Integrated Cognitive Control Training demonstrates efficacy in depression proof-of-concept trial](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360264)** — *medRxiv*
  * A 16-patient open-label study evaluated a 5-session manualized Integrated Cognitive Control Training (ICCT) program in patients with clinical depression.
  * Treated patients showed significant improvements in cognitive flexibility (Color Trails Test-2: d = 0.88, p = 0.003) and depression severity on the MADRS scale (d = 1.67, p < 0.001).

* **[Study protocol details Phase 1/2 LPS-Boost trial of intensified ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA-617 in mCRPC](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42595485/)** — *PubMed*
  * Outlines the protocol for a clinical trial evaluating intensified ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA-617 radioligand therapy in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients displaying low baseline PSMA expression.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **[Taiho and Cullinan’s zipalertinib succeeds early in Phase 3 EGFR exon 20 NSCLC trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/taiho-cullinan-zipalertinib-egfr-exon20-lung-cancer-results/827785/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The Phase 3 trial combining zipalertinib with chemotherapy in frontline EGFR exon 20 insertion non-small cell lung cancer was unblinded early after meeting its primary endpoint with a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival.
  * The FDA is currently reviewing zipalertinib as a second-line treatment, with a decision expected by Feb. 27.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AbbVie’s upadacitinib meets primary endpoints in dual Phase 3 vitiligo studies](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)00896-2/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
  * Results from two Phase 3 randomized controlled trials (Viti-Up) showed that upadacitinib (15 mg once daily) achieved clinically meaningful repigmentation of both facial and total body surface area in adults and adolescents with non-segmental vitiligo.
  * Safety findings aligned with the established profile of oral JAK1 inhibition, with no new safety signals reported.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Re-analysis of semaglutide Phase 3 evoke trials highlights primary prevention potential in Alzheimer's](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01647-8/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
  * A commentary on the evoke and evoke+ Phase 3 trials noted that while oral semaglutide failed to slow progression in established early Alzheimer's disease, GLP-1 receptor agonists may still demonstrate utility if administered as primary prevention before cognitive onset.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA grants accelerated approval to BMS’s iberdomide (Zenbexus) for multiple myeloma](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-iberdomide-daratumumab-and-hyaluronidase-fihj-and-dexamethasone)** — *FDA*
  * Granted accelerated approval to iberdomide in combination with daratumumab, hyaluronidase-fihj, and dexamethasone for adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who received ≥1 prior line of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent.
  * Approval was supported by efficacy data from the Phase 3 EXCALIBER-RRMM trial (NCT04975997).

* **[FDA outlines Operation TrialBlazer and Expedited IND pilot program](http://www.fda.gov/industry/fda-actions-accelerate-and-modernize-early-and-late-stage-clinical-development)** — *FDA*
  * Announced details on the Expedited IND pilot program under HHS’s Operation TrialBlazer, designed to streamline regulatory requirements and reduce time to first-in-human clinical trials.
  * Highlighted the Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program, utilizing collaborative tumor-board style reviews to accelerate therapies aligning with national health priorities.

* **[Health Canada and Australia TGA issue safety warnings on Vitamin B6-induced neuropathy](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/new-cautions-about-vitamin-b6-and-peripheral-neuropathy/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=new-cautions-about-vitamin-b6-and-peripheral-neuropathy)** — *Science-Based Medicine*
  * Health Canada published a safety bulletin identifying peripheral neuropathy risks associated with low-to-moderate doses of pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) in health products.
  * Australia’s TGA rescheduled higher-dose Vitamin B6 formulations to require pharmacist consultation based on reports of nerve damage occurring well below historical safety thresholds.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[PTC Therapeutics acquires Sangamo’s Fabry gene therapy ST-920 in bankruptcy sale](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ptc-sangamo-fabry-gene-therapy-bankruptcy-sale-lilly/827767/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * PTC agreed to pay up to $211 million to acquire isaralgagene civaparvovec (ST-920), an AAV-based gene therapy for Fabry disease, from Sangamo Therapeutics during bankruptcy proceedings.
  * Sangamo had initiated a rolling BLA submission to the FDA; PTC plans to complete the filing in Q4 2026, aiming for a potential commercial launch in 2027.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Eli Lilly targets illicit grey market sales of investigational retatrutide](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/13/biotech-news-eli-lilly-targets-booming-retatrutide-black-market/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  * Eli Lilly initiated legal enforcement and supply-chain oversight actions targeting illicit online vendors selling unapproved active pharmaceutical ingredient forms of its GLP-1/GIP/glucagon tri-agonist retatrutide.

* **[Biotech]** **[Avidity Biosciences earns $15M milestone payment from BMS](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087872485538635859)** — *@BioStocks on X*
  * Earned a $15 million milestone payment under its global cardiovascular drug discovery collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb.

* **[Biotech]** **[Biotech equity financings and runway updates: AbCellera, Outlook, and Nektar](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087841982525620440)** — *@BioStocks on X*
  * AbCellera priced a $200 million public offering at $9.75 per share.
  * Outlook Therapeutics priced a $55 million offering at $0.99 per share, marking its fourth public offering YTD.
  * Nektar Therapeutics updated its financial projections, extending its projected cash runway into Q3 2028.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[Dutch surveillance cohort links event-driven PrEP to higher HIV incidence than daily PrEP](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360235)** — *medRxiv*
  * Real-world surveillance data from the Dutch national PrEP program (2019–2025) demonstrated a statistically significant increase in HIV acquisition among individuals using event-driven (2-1-1) oral PrEP compared to daily oral PrEP regimens.

* **[Active mpox surveillance deployed during mass gathering in Uganda](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360261)** — *medRxiv*
  * Syndromic screening and emergency medical service reviews conducted during the 2025 Uganda Martyrs Day mass gathering identified active mpox-compatible cases, providing operational frameworks for real-time surveillance during regional outbreaks.

* **[Regulatory fragmentation identified as primary barrier to regional vaccine self-reliance](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04580-7)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Analysis details how unharmonized national regulatory requirements across low- and middle-income countries impede regional vaccine manufacturing, distribution, and crisis response capabilities.

* **[California generic insulin distribution reaches initial milestone](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/13/california-insulin-sales-moderna-patent-battle/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  * Under the CalRx initiative, California has distributed over 120,000 five-pen packs of generic insulin glargine priced at $55 each, though broader retail market adoption remains slow.

**Worth watching:** The upcoming Feb. 27 FDA decision on zipalertinib in second-line EGFR exon 20 NSCLC, which now has frontline momentum following Phase 3 early unblinding.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [More Exercise = More Plaque - Why?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ibfahpJWOWQ) -- Physionic
        - Evaluates the paradoxical relationship between high-volume endurance exercise and the development of coronary artery plaque and atherosclerosis in athletes.
        - Explores mechanisms behind exercise-associated vascular changes, including exercise-induced occult hypertension and training-induced endothelial dysfunction.
        - Examines the role of low-density lipoprotein (LDL) oxidation susceptibility and plasma antioxidant modifications resulting from extreme endurance activities like marathons.
        - Contrasts the prevalence, progression, and calcification of coronary plaques between lifelong middle-aged athletes and physically active or sedentary controls.
    - [Who Actually Profits From AI in Healthcare?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RDEUpUX6DOo) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Features George Mathew discussing the economic impact of integrating artificial intelligence into healthcare systems.
        - Analyzes how AI-driven operational efficiencies and cost reductions affect broader healthcare pricing dynamics.
        - Explores why financial savings generated by healthcare AI are largely absorbed by companies and institutional providers rather than passed down to patients.
- Pure Science
    - [Why UFOs Aren’t Evidence of Aliens](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nDcAo0cXl3g) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Features astronomer David Kipping outlining a rigorous scientific framework for searching for intelligent extraterrestrial life.
        - Explains why UFO observations fail to meet scientific standards of evidence for extraterrestrial civilizations.
        - Details the analytical difficulties involved in detecting and accurately interpreting planetary biosignatures.
        - Suggests exomoons as an underrated and potential candidate region for discovering life outside the solar system.
- Other
    - [Is it Possible to Prepare for an Earthquake?: Crash Course Geology #15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xYKSKBcifaE) -- CrashCourse
        - Details the geological mechanisms of tectonic faults and the physical risks associated with major seismic events.
        - Reviews structural engineering techniques and earthquake-proofing methods designed to protect infrastructure.
        - Provides practical individual preparedness procedures and safety responses for surviving high-magnitude earthquakes.
